attributes.title: 2027 NASW-LA Annual Conference: Advocacy in Action: The Power of Social Work
attributes.venue: Crowne Plaza Baton Rouge Executive Center
attributes.organizer: National Association of Social Workers, Louisiana Chapter
attributes.summary:
The Louisiana Chapter of NASW holds its 2027 annual conference March 10 to 12, 2027, at the Crowne Plaza Baton Rouge Executive Center, under the theme "Advocacy in Action: The Power of Social Work." The chapter describes it as a two-and-a-half-day event that usually draws more than 700 social workers, allied professionals and students, with an exhibit hall of more than 50 booths.

Registration details and the 2027 program are not published yet. For comparison, the chapter's 2026 brochure offered up to 20 contact hours for attending the full three-day conference, with sessions labelled clinical or general CEU. Check the 2027 brochure once it is released for the confirmed hours.

A room block at the Crowne Plaza is held at $118 per night plus tax until February 8, 2027, or until it fills (group code ASW).
